Description:
[size=5][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#980000][center]UPDATE!!!:[/center][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]
[/font][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#cccccc][center]After being away for 2 years, I've retouched Rasmodia's portraits and characters to make them much prettier. Also to correct an error in your installation. So it should be fixed now and will obviously look much better than before.[/center]
[/color][/font][/b][/size][center][size=5][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#cccccc]Enjoy!!!

[/color][/font][/b][/size][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6fa8dc][size=5][b]Description:[/b][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Comic Sans MS] [size=4]This mod would be Seasonal Rasmodia, its anime version made to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] I used the portrait of the Ohodavi witch. Based on the female wizard mod by creepycat. And I modified them to my style so that it changes according to the season you have in your game ❤️ (Spring🌷, Summer ☀️, Fall 🍁 and Winter ⛄)[/size]

[size=4]The mod only changes the visual of the wizard, that is, its portraits and characters. This does not replace any dialogue or anything similar. I'm afraid my Rasmodia was talking like a man 😥 (There are currently mods that can fix this, so i recommend using them )[/size]

[size=4][center]💕 Without further ado, enjoy my first mod ❤️

🔧 P.D: If you find any errors, tell me and I will fix it immediately. 🔧[/center][/size][/font]

[size=5][color=#93c47d][b] [font=Comic Sans MS][center]Installation:[/center][/font][/b][/color][/size][center]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][color=#6aa84f] 1-  [/color][b]First download the mod:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#d98f40][size=4]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/size][/color][/font][/url]. [/b][b]And then paste it into your mods folder.
[/b]
[color=#6aa84f]2-  [/color][color=#f4f4f4][b]Download and extract my mod to your downloads folder. Next take my mod and paste it into your mods folder and click replace all.

[/b][/color][b][color=#6aa84f]3- [/color][color=#f4f4f4]¡¡¡Congratulations!!! The installation is complete. Just enjoy my mod 🤩[/color]﻿[/b][/size]
[/font][/center]
